Method of Attack: Ransomware deployment after stealing sensitive documents from compromised systems
Use of custom VSS Copying Tool to steal files from shadow volume copies even when in use
Email communication for ransom negotiation instead of Tor negotiation pages
Threat of leaking stolen data online to pressure victims
Discoverer: Australian Signals Directorate's Australian Cyber Security Centre (ASD's ACSC)
Impacted Systems: Businesses and critical infrastructure in North America, South America, and Europe
Attack Vector: Compromise of systems to steal sensitive documents before ransomware deployment
Indicators of Compromise: Approximately 300 affected entities worldwide as of October 2023
